plan.goal: Add deterministic established-state command, full-snapshot, acknowledgement, bounded-history and resync transfer to Session.
acceptance: Expose only Enqueue, Capture and NeedsSnapshot on Session and preserve every frozen Core contract.
Implement exact role/state, packet-field, priority, acknowledgement, retry, sequence and error mappings.
Own outbox, dispatcher, history and pending snapshot leases transactionally across construction, steps and disposal.
Use full snapshots only; do not add delta, rollback, prediction, diagnostics, Unity or real transport behavior.
Pass focused, full package and post-integration Unity EditMode validation.

execution.handoff: Implement the frozen transfer contract from exact baseline ee5968c3001c35353df45035916e9ea0f660a42e in the isolated worktree; change only owned paths and create one candidate commit.
validationEvidence: Baseline review cycle 1 requested exact retry-ack freezing, reachable history/apply tests, callback exception semantics, and public/protocol precedence refinements.
Baseline review cycle 2 resolved the original blockers but requires reliable-intent serialization and exact Capture/history exception scope.
Replan serializes one active reliable intent, freezes transactional Capture exceptions, and excludes process-level allocator failure recovery from the Session protocol contract.
Post-Replan review requires Requested-close interlock, queued versus active resync distinction, and monotonic cross-domain acknowledgement tracking.
Post-Replan cycle 2 found that snapshot acknowledgement ordering must treat NoneTick as a logical bottom sentinel instead of numeric uint max.
Replan freezes domain-aware acknowledgement ordering: NoneTick and command zero are bottom sentinels, then real values advance monotonically.
The restarted Strict baseline review was accepted by gpt-5.6-sol:high at planning head e5071746f6e5e97145ba35a4436e82fc45f00604.
Candidate e2f25f2fb95a56934ec8aefe338a946501748c0d changes exactly seven owned paths; focused SessionTransfer tests pass 28/28 and warnings-as-errors compilation reports 0 warnings/0 errors.
The standalone package harness reports 130 passed and one pre-existing SessionTests allocation assertion at +24 bytes; the candidate adds no failing transfer test.
